body:
Documentation follow-up: I found that the SenseVoice English/Chinese READMEs still described an earlier reply in [SenseVoice #334](https://github.com/QwenAudio/SenseVoice/issues/334) as a completed official clarification, despite the later [reopening for license-owner/core-maintainer confirmation](https://github.com/QwenAudio/SenseVoice/issues/334#issuecomment-5463240506).

[SenseVoice PR #357](https://github.com/QwenAudio/SenseVoice/pull/357) corrects that inconsistency. I also added a prominent status notice to the [earlier reply](https://github.com/QwenAudio/SenseVoice/issues/334#issuecomment-5083546605), retaining the original text as discussion history. The README correction is proposed, not yet merged.

This is a documentation-status correction only. It does **not** establish which license version applies to the pinned weights/ONNX artifacts, grant redistribution or commercial-use rights, or answer the other licensing questions in this report. Those questions remain open for the relevant license owner; neither the earlier reply nor this PR should be used as a substitute for that confirmation. No artifact re-upload is requested, and I am keeping this issue open.
